title: E-QTM-0158: the path integral on the working rule, pass: the rule's state IS the sum over take histories, enumerated...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0158 in the quantum arena: the path integral on the working rule, pass: the rule's state IS the sum over take histories, enumerated one history at a time without the rule's beat, term for term (one love to beat 12, two loves with their meetings and link point moves to beat 8, 0 mismatches on 17 of 17 starts; the sum with the meeting left out fails on every start whose run has an unequal-point meeting, 15 of 17); the sum is coherent from beat 3 (L1 0.5625 against the incoherent sum); its long-time limit is stationary phase, E[v^2] 0.134112 to 0.133975 at T = 64 to 1024 against (1/2 pi) int W'^2 = 1 - sqrt 3/2, peaked at the caustic |v| = 0.494 below the top speed 1/2, where the dephased sum diffuses (T E[v^2] 0.334); one dimension, along a line.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
